== Template ==

Hello. What wiki were you thinking of using the chapter summary template on? If you need any help, let me know. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 22:22, May 23, 2013 (UTC)

Thanks, for the offer. I am working on [[w:c:stormlightarchive|StormLight Archive]] Wikia. Our chapter summaries pages look very similar to yours([[w:c:stormlightarchive:The_Way_of_Kings:_Chapter_1|for example]]). I am toying with the idea of adding a chapter index on the side like you do( [[w:c:stormlightarchive:User:Mbg2/sandbox#collapsible|draft]]) to improve navigation, but I don't want it to overburden the page.--[[User:Mbg2|Mbg2]] ([[User talk:Mbg2|talk]]) 22:52, May 23, 2013 (UTC)
